integrity: The proof is unrestricted and exhausts the prime-square, squarefree-semiprime, prime-cube, repeated-prime three-factor, and squarefree three-prime shapes. The finite verifier is corroborative only.
scientific_limitations: The theorem classifies only composite solutions with \(\Omega(n)\le3\) and identifies a sharp \(\Omega(n)=4\) witness. It does not classify the full \(\Omega(n)=4\) layer or any higher layer.
title: The first multiplicity layer of the cototient–aliquot divisibility
